Sameera Reddy backs Katrina Kaif amid postpartum body-shaming

Actress Sameera Reddy has expressed solidarity with Katrina Kaif following postpartum body-shaming directed at Kaif. Reddy stated she embraces being called 'curvy, chubby, thick, golu'. This comes after Salman Khan previously criticized trolls for body-shaming.
